detailed_description: The Reading Time Calculator estimates reading and speaking time from pasted plain text in the browser. It counts words, characters, sentences, and paragraphs, updates the results as the text changes, and lets you adjust the reading speed with a words-per-minute slider. Reading time uses the selected WPM value, while speaking time uses a fixed average speaking rate. The reference panel shows slow, average, and fast WPM ranges for quick comparison.
usage_steps: Adjust the reading speed slider if you want to use a different WPM value.
Review the word, character, sentence, and paragraph counts.
Check the estimated reading time and speaking time cards.
usage_examples: Estimate how long a blog intro may take to read at 200 words per minute.
Compare reading time after shortening a help article draft.
Adjust the WPM slider to model slower or faster reading speeds.
Check speaking time for a pasted script before recording a short narration.
